title: NEURA Robotics 建立 NEURA Gym RWTH Aachen 来训练物理人工智能
summary: NEURA Robotics has partnered with a German university for NEURA Gym RWTH Aachen, one of 10 facilities for training physical AI. The post NEURA Robotics establishes NEURA Gym RWTH Aachen to train physical AI appeared first on The Robot Report .（原题：NEURA Robotics establishes NEURA Gym RWTH Aachen to train physical AI）
